To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) CBT can be used to increase x-ray interpretation competency; (ii) IEFs can increase image quality and thereby improve image interpretation; (iii) the use of multi-view x-rays can improve image quality and thereby increase image interpretation efficiency; (iv) x-ray image difficulty can be predicted using a statistical model; (v) human performance can be predicted using the same statistical model.

CBT is a very effective way to improve human performance in x-ray screening; CBT can be used to measure the x-ray image interpretation competence of individuals and groups; the difficulty of x-ray images can be predicted using statistical modeling, and IEFs and multi-view technology are effective ways to improve the performance of x-ray screening.
the following factors are important for the interpretation of x-rays: (i) the type of object, (ii) the type of threat, (iii) image enhancement functions and (iv) the number of images.
In summary, our research is concerned with
improving the quality and efficiency of x-ray screening.
the question of how to increase the performance of security screeners in x-ray screening.
the development of methods for improving human performance in x-ray screening by means of computer-based training, image enhancement functions, and multi-view technology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of CBT is the most efficient way to enhance human-machine-interaction in x-ray screening.
the use of CBT is a valuable way to improve human-machine interaction in airport x-ray screening.

CBT is a valuable and efficient way to increase x-ray image interpretation performance, that IEFs are of limited use, but that multi-view technology is a promising way to improve human-machine interaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

CBT can improve the performance of x-ray screeners, that IEFs and multi-view technology can improve the performance, that IEF and multi-view technology are not necessarily mutually exclusive, and that CBT can be used to improve the efficiency of training.
x-ray image interpretation can be enhanced using CBT and that the efficiency of x-ray screening can be increased by using multi-view and/or image enhancement technology.
CBT can be a powerful tool for increasing human performance in the x-ray screening task.

the use of CBT can improve x-ray image interpretation skills and that the use of IEFs and multi-view technology can enhance human performance.
the efficiency of x-ray screening is highly dependent on human factors.
